tagline_en: A donation that becomes a voucher, by itself
summary_he: אוטומציה שמקבלת פרטי תרומה, נותנת לתורם לבחור היכן לממש שובר, מפיקה שובר מעוצב עם מספר ייחודי ושולחת אותו במייל, ומתריעה לבעל העסק כשמלאי מתקרב לסיום.
summary_en: An automation that ingests donation details, lets the donor pick a redemption location, generates a designed voucher with a unique number, emails it automatically, and alerts the operator before any location runs low on stock.
sourcing_note: Reconstructed from the operator's description of the workflow, not from a shared source repository. Architecture and code are a representative reference implementation of that workflow.
problem: Every donation required manual work: opening the confirmation email, copying the donor's details by hand, preparing a document, typing a unique voucher number, and emailing it back — slow, error-prone, and delayed for the donor.
solution: A system that closes the whole loop automatically: donation in, donor chooses a location, voucher generated with a unique number, emailed in seconds, stock decremented, and low-stock alerts raised ahead of time — all visible on one dashboard.
result: What took minutes of copy-paste per donor now happens by itself in seconds: fewer errors, an instant response to the donor, and full visibility of the whole operation.
features: Automatic intake of donation details (no manual copy-paste from email)
Donor-facing form to choose the voucher redemption location
Automatic generation of a designed voucher with a unique, never-reused number
Instant email delivery of the voucher to the donor
Automatic per-location stock decrement on issue
Early low-stock alerts to the operator, before a location runs out
Operator dashboard with the full picture: donations, vouchers, stock, alerts
highlights: Unique voucher numbering enforced by the database (sequence + unique constraint), not by manual care
Voucher issuance is a single atomic transaction: reserve number, decrement stock, create voucher — all or nothing
Stock guard (remaining > 0) makes overselling impossible even under concurrency
Edge-triggered, de-duplicated low-stock alerts: one alert per crossing, auto-resolved on replenishment
Email delivery happens after commit, tracked as its own state, with retries on transient failure

reference_stack.note: One sound way to build the described workflow; not a claim about a specific deployment.
reference_stack.scheduling: Lightweight job runner for retries and reconciliation

metrics_illustrative.note: Illustrative example figures used in the demo, not real client data.

privacy: All names, emails, partner locations, amounts, and voucher numbers are examples. No secrets, no real client identity.
